intro: Palau is a small island nation in the western Pacific, world-famous for its marine life and ocean protection.

chapters.title: Early Palauans
text: People reached Palau around 3,000 years ago or more. Badrulchau on Babeldaob has rows of ancient stone monoliths. Palauans quarried stone money for Yap.

chapters.title: Colonial rule and war
text: Spain, then Germany from 1899, then Japan from 1914 ruled Palau. The 1944 Battle of Peleliu between the US and Japan was one of the bloodiest of the Pacific war.

highlight.title: Peleliu
highlight.text: Wrecks and relics of the battle remain.

chapters.title: Independence
text: Palau became independent in 1994 in free association with the US, after many referendums.
